episode.intent: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
episode.error: OperationalError: ORDER BY clause should come after UNION ALL not before
episode.error_signature: order by clause should come after union all not before
episode.failed_sql:
WITH seg AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT 'biggest' AS which, segment, pct FROM (
  SELECT segment, ((c2013 - c2012) / NULLIF(c2013,0) * 100.0) AS pct FROM seg
) ORDER BY pct DESC LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lowest' AS which, segment, pct FROM (
  SELECT segment, ((c2013 - c2012) / NULLIF(c2013,0) * 100.0) AS pct FROM seg
) ORDER BY pct ASC LIMIT 1;
episode.remediation_sql:
WITH seg AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
seg_pct AS (
  SELECT segment,
         ((c2013 - c2012) / NULLIF(c2012,0) * 100.0) AS pct
  FROM seg
)
SELECT 'biggest' AS which, s.segment, s.pct
FROM seg_pct s
JOIN (SELECT MAX(pct) AS pct FROM seg_pct) m ON s.pct = m.pct
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lowest' AS which, s.segment, s.pct
FROM seg_pct s
JOIN (SELECT MIN(pct) AS pct FROM seg_pct) m ON s.pct = m.pct;
